# OpenCascade kernel (WebAssembly)

`replicad_single.js` / `replicad_single.wasm` come unmodified from the npm package
[`replicad-opencascadejs` 1.1.0](https://www.npmjs.com/package/replicad-opencascadejs) (a custom build of
[opencascade.js](https://github.com/donalffons/opencascade.js) made for [replicad](https://github.com/sgenoud/replicad)).

- Open CASCADE Technology is licensed under the GNU LGPL 2.1 with the Open CASCADE exception:
  https://dev.opencascade.org/resources/licensing
- The package itself is published under LGPL-2.1-only.

The files are redistributed as is; to rebuild or replace them, follow the instructions of the projects above.
